name: Section
summary: An edge-to-edge band of a website page, with its own surface, site spacing and, optionally, its own theme. variant="footer" makes it the site's footer.

a11y.apg: A <section> element. It is only announced as a region (a landmark) when it has an accessible name, so give the band a heading and point aria-labelledby at it when screen-reader users should be able to jump to it. No keyboard interaction: it is a layout band. With variant="footer" it is a <footer>, which is the page's contentinfo landmark when it is not nested in another sectioning element; its links sit in a <nav> named by `navLabel`, each column under an <h2>.

props.name: surface
props.description: The band's background: the page's (the default), a card surface, or the recessed inset surface (GAR-04, 06/10/2026).

props.name: spacing
props.description: The space above and below: md is --space-16 (64) and --space-24 (96) from the md breakpoint up; sm is half of that. Aurea's choice from existing tokens: none of the references had a section to read.

props.name: theme
props.description: A theme for this band only (GAR-05): theme="dark" makes a dark band inside a light page, and the other way round. The background, the text and every piece inside follow the band's theme, and the page's light-theme rules do not leak into it.

props.name: variant
props.description: footer makes the band the website's footer (GAR-06, 07/10/2026): a <footer> with the brand, the link columns and the legal line, its content already in a Container. Surface, spacing and theme keep working — a dark footer on a light page is theme="dark". On a phone everything stacks in one column.

props.name: brand
props.description: Footer only: the brand and a short line, top left.

props.name: links
props.description: Footer only: the link columns, each { title, items }. The items are SidebarItem (id, label, href, render), the same shape as the menus. From 768px the columns share the width, each at least 8rem.

props.name: legal
props.description: Footer only: the bottom line — rights, terms, privacy — under a hairline.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Footer only: how far the content grows, on the Container's scale.

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Footer only: the footer navigation's name for screen readers. Pass it in the page's language.

props.name: children
props.description: The band's content, usually inside a Container.
